title: Sources: Meta plans to release a camera-free pair of smart glasses this fall; the new model has six mics to let users speak with Meta's AI chatbot and Muse (Jyoti Mann/The Information)
summary: Jyoti Mann / The Information: Sources: Meta plans to release a camera-free pair of smart glasses this fall; the new model has six mics to let users speak with Meta's AI chatbot and Muse — Meta Platforms plans to release a camera-free pair of smart glasses this fall, according to people familiar with the matter …
